As of today, no clickbait titles will be allowed to be posted.

This includes the following:

1. Posting an article that announces a release date, but there is no release date included in the title.

a. Example: Halo 6 release date announced! - this is bad.

b. Halo 6 release date announced! (11/6/2017) - this is good

2. Posting an article that leaves out other basic information that could be included in the title

a. IGN names their game of the year - this is bad.

b. Pool Nation FX is IGN's game of the year! - this is good.

When there are short information articles that are posted, or content that doesn't require the user to read the entire article/view the webpage/or they can't view it because they are at work, please include that information in the title.

Additionally, you will now be able to track all moderator announcements in the sidebar, under the moderation logs column. This will be open to public view so you can see all changes made to the subverse. You can view that here: https://voat.co/v/xboxone/comments/751779

If you have any suggestions, or concerns, please comment here.
